{{Ship module infobox}}

The '''Guardian Shield Reinforcement Package''' is an optional internal module derived from [[Guardian]] technology. While powered and used with an active [[Shield Generator]], it adds a fixed amount of shield capacity measured in megajoules. Multiple packages can be fitted, and their listed additions stack directly.<ref name="module-data">[https://raw.githubusercontent.com/EDCD/coriolis-data/d4efdee1808b45ae7c60b9b30223b670375e95a4/modules/internal/guardian_shield_reinforcement_package.json EDCD Coriolis Data: Guardian Shield Reinforcement Package records], commit pinned; accessed 15 September 2026.</ref><ref name="gsrp-wiki">[https://elite-dangerous.fandom.com/wiki/Guardian_Shield_Reinforcement_Package Elite Dangerous Wiki: Guardian Shield Reinforcement Package], accessed 15 September 2026.</ref>

The package is available in Classes 1–5 with E- and D-rated versions. D-rated packages are lighter and add more shield capacity, while E-rated packages draw slightly less power and cost less. Every standard variant has 36 module integrity.

The maintained community datasets consulted for this page contain minor price discrepancies: the Elite Dangerous Wiki lists 57,000 Cr for the 3E package and values each Class 5 package 2 Cr below EDCD's records. The table uses EDCD's 3E value and the current Elite Dangerous Wiki Class 5 values. These discrepancies do not affect module performance.<ref name="module-data" /><ref name="gsrp-wiki" />

== Shield-strength behavior ==

The package's megajoule value is a flat addition, not a percentage bonus. Percentage increases from [[Shield Booster]]s apply to the Shield Generator's output before the Guardian package is added; they do not multiply the package's listed MJ. Shield resistances still determine how much incoming damage the completed shield can absorb against each damage type.<ref name="gsrp-wiki" />

Fitting another Guardian package adds its own listed value. Because the Shield Generator's recharge and recovery rates are not increased by the package, a larger completed shield takes correspondingly longer to recharge from empty if nothing else changes.

This module occupies an internal compartment and draws continuous power. A Shield Booster instead occupies a utility mount, adds a percentage of the generator's base strength, and can be Engineered for strength or resistance. Neither is a universal replacement for the other.

== Unlock and acquisition ==

The module requires one permanent unlock at a '''Guardian Technology Broker'''. The recorded unlock cost is:<ref name="gsrp-wiki" />

* 1 Guardian Module Blueprint Fragment
* 17 Guardian Power Cells
* 20 Guardian Technology Components
* 24 Pattern Delta Obelisk Data
* 8 Hardware Diagnostic Sensors

After the unlock, additional packages are purchased for credits through outfitting where stocked; the materials are not paid again for every ordinary copy. Broker locations and station stock are dynamic.<ref>[https://inara.cz/elite/techbroker/ INARA: Technology Broker unlocks], accessed 15 September 2026.</ref>

== Engineering ==

Guardian Shield Reinforcement Packages do not accept Shield Generator or Shield Booster blueprints, nor their Experimental Effects.

In Live, the single-grade '''Anti-Guardian Zone Resistance''' modification can be applied to the package. It prevents anti-Guardian fields from degrading the module and has no performance penalty.<ref>[https://www.elitedangerous.com/update-notes/4-0-18-07 Frontier Developments: Elite Dangerous 18.07 Update Notes], accessed 15 September 2026.</ref> It is not available in Legacy.
